title: Commendation
text: Accord, this is Mission Control. If this recording is playing, your first good report has just come in. Well done.

lines.text: Every sol you send one, someone here reads it. A healthy world, a growing colony, the animals left in their place: that's the whole of the job, and you're doing it.
Keep the numbers high. We're proud of you.

choices.label: "Thank you."
choices.reply: The recording ends on her folded hands. You play it twice more before the next shift starts. Nobody needs to know that.

choices.label: Play it to the colony
choices.reply: It goes out on the Civilian Center's screen. Somebody claps. {first} watches you watch it.

notes: Makes the score something to chase (v0.89.0): the first report graded B or better (flag report-good, src/sim/planet.ts). Pays off at the Foundry: director-three finds ACCORD COMMENDATION, TAKE 1 on the shelf.
